app.notes: Counting made exact. The app now says when it is opened (a random number for the computer, the version, and Windows or Mac, nothing else), so the website counts the computers using it instead of estimating from downloads. Use Gonka totals go out every fifteen minutes instead of once a day. Two small counting faults are fixed: answers that arrived during a send could be lost, and two sends at once could count the same answers twice. The app says all of this plainly on the service list, the Account page and the Gonka Host Setup welcome screen. Electron is updated to 44.7.0 for its security fixes.
